problem: The installed codec's ext=true DXF read projects TEXT, INSERT and 2D POLYLINE coordinates that LibreCAD's bundled reader delivers in their source frames. LibreCAD then applied its bundled-reader assumptions, causing reflected coordinates to be transformed twice and successive saves to change them.
change: The system-codec adapter reads DXF source coordinates and, using one shared helper, projects the CIRCLE, ARC, TRACE/SOLID, LWPOLYLINE and ATTDEF callbacks for which the bundled reader supplies projected values. TEXT, INSERT, attributes, legacy POLYLINE, dimensions and underlays retain their source callback frames. A negative-normal DXF ELLIPSE keeps its WCS center and major axis and reverses its parameter interval when normalized to +Z. The DXF reader pointer is cleared after both success and failure so later DWG callbacks on the same filter are not mistaken for DXF callbacks. The library's default 3D-facing read behavior is unchanged.
authority: Autodesk ELLIPSE DXF reference identifies center and major-axis vector as WCS: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2018/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-107CB04F-AD4D-4D2F-8EC9-AC90888063AB.htm
Autodesk arbitrary-axis algorithm defines the OCS basis from the extrusion normal: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E19E5B42-0CC7-4EBA-B29F-5E1D595149EE.htm
